name: Agent Workforce (internal trial)
note: Workforce-internal project bundling team-shared resources used by trial CCR-bound skills. Holds the team Discord webhook URL (consumed by Yuki's discord-heartbeat and Priya's weekly discord-digest), the feed-write token (Dario's feed-post), and the Notion integration token for Elena's 2-hourly article-level2 (L1→L2 explanation, via the CCR agent-runner). Only the apiKey is secret: pick-l1-source.mjs (reads the L1 source library + unified coverage) and publish-notion.mjs (writes the explanation to the unified Articles DB) hold both DB ids as script constants — they are non-secret and already committed in newsletter/gas/src/Code.gs + newsletter/pipeline/normalize-categories.mjs. orchestrator-tick resolves wf/projects/agent-workforce/notion.integration_token and ships the apiKey inline. Members grow as more agents flip skills to the CCR path. Not a customer project — this is the operational substrate the workforce itself runs on.
